text:
```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement U12_4/1: Add a new (unique) Doctor
Conditions:
- Doctor Name (unique)
- Age
- Sex
- Qualification
- Experience
- Speciality
Actions:
- Add Doctor (PASS/FAIL)
Rules:
1. Name unique, all other fields valid -> PASS
2. Name duplicate -> FAIL
3. Any field invalid (e.g., negative age) -> FAIL

Decision Table for Requirement U12_4/2: View and Update existing Doctor details
Conditions:
- Doctor ID (exists)
- Attempted field to update (Name, Age, Sex, Qualification, Experience, Speciality)
Actions:
- View Doctor Details (PASS)
- Update Doctor (PASS/FAIL)
Rules:
1. View any field -> PASS
2. Attempt to update Speciality -> FAIL
3. Attempt to update any other field with valid data -> PASS
4. Attempt to update with invalid data -> FAIL

Decision Table for Requirement U12_4/3: Delete Doctor Details
Conditions:
- Doctor ID (exists)
- Pending Patient Consultation Request (Yes/No)
Actions:
- Delete Doctor (PASS/FAIL)
Rules:
1. No pending request -> PASS
2. Pending request -> FAIL

Decision Table for Requirement U12_3/1: Add a new Chemist or Lab
Conditions:
- Pincode
- Existing Chemist/Lab in Pincode (Yes/No)
Actions:
- Add Chemist/Lab (PASS/FAIL)
Rules:
1. No existing Chemist/Lab in Pincode -> PASS
2. Existing Chemist/Lab in Pincode -> FAIL

Decision Table for Requirement U12_3/2: View and Update existing Chemist/Lab details
Conditions:
- Chemist/Lab ID (exists)
- Attempted field to update (Name, Pincode, ...)
Actions:
- View Details (PASS)
- Update Details (PASS/FAIL)
Rules:
1. View any field -> PASS
2. Attempt to update Pincode -> FAIL
3. Attempt to update any other field with valid data -> PASS
4. Attempt to update with invalid data -> FAIL

Decision Table for Requirement U12_3/3: Delete Chemist/Lab Details
Conditions:
- Chemist/Lab ID (exists)
- Pending Prescription (Yes/No)
Actions:
- Delete Chemist/Lab (PASS/FAIL)
Rules:
1. No pending prescription -> PASS
2. Pending prescription -> FAIL
```
